title: India’s Merchandise Exports Rise 15.92% to US$ 129.32 Billion in Q1 FY27; Total Exports Cross US$ 232.73 Billion
description: India's total exports reached US$ 232.73 billion during April-June FY27, driven by 15.92% growth in merchandise exports, robust non-petroleum exports and strong performance across engineering goods, electronics, gems & jewellery and chemicals.
